reviews.review: This was one of the best best games that I had played the year that it had came out, and to be honest, a game that was probably the highest rated for me. I didn't buy too many games in 2013, and didn't actually purchase this until 2015, and I'm regretting not getting it sooner. This game is so easy to lose time in, with the unlockable characters and the levels the generate differently each time. To be honest, if you play on easy (Which can still get pretty tough) the game is pretty short. But the difficulty puts you on your toes so much, it's honestly such a blast. And that soundtrack! Chris Christodoulou did an amazing job and that soundtrack. It fits perfectly with the game. I bought it immediately after dying my first time. Paid $10 first time I bought it, I would have paid $15. You need to have this game in your library, it's absolutely worth it.
